title: A Holographic Map from AdS$_3$ to CFT$_2$
summary: We propose a holographic map from the semiclassical Hilbert space of pure general relativity in $\text{AdS}_{3}$ to that of $\text{CFT}_{2}$. We define the bulk Hilbert space by semiclassically quantising the phase space in the basis of a fixed-area network on a Cauchy slice $Σ$. A fixed-area network is a maximal non-intersecting set of geodesics on $Σ$ whose lengths and angular momenta have been fixed.
